annotations.text:
(Recommended) Counter A · axis: 4-up ledger, hairline rules, clay numerals.
Why: it is the live strip (counter-home-1280) tightened, so zero copy risk on the page's highest-traffic surface; the measured problem on this homepage was hero height, not the counter, and 172px desktop is the shortest 4-up of the three.
Trade-off: its separation is the minimum layout-hero-counter-separation allows (tone shift plus a 1px rule), so any later edit that drops the border re-breaks the gate.

Counter B · axis: 2×2 tiles on the #f6efe8 bed with a 3px forest→clay top bar.
Why: rules/design.md names this exact marker as the for-sale cluster's shipped separation, so the seam is unmistakable and survives edits; the side-by-side numeral and label reads as four statements, not four decorations.
Trade-off: 234px desktop and 354px at Mobile, the tallest of the three, for the same four facts.

Counter C · axis: inline ribbon, numerals and labels on one line, horizontally scrollable at Mobile.
Why: 126px desktop and 120px at Mobile, it costs the least vertical space of any option and keeps the four facts on one reading line directly under the hero seam.
Trade-off: the numerals drop to 24px and stop reading as claims, and at Mobile the fourth stat is off-screen until the reader scrolls the ribbon sideways.
